message: XML schema validation issue within Define.xml
description: There is an XML schema validation issue with either Define.xml structure or content that is not covered by one of the other rules. It is most likely an issue with element declarations.

Define.xml must reference the following namespaces: 1) CDISC ODM xmlns="http://www.cdisc.org/ns/odm/v1.3" for Define-XML v2.0 and v2.1 or xmlns="http://www.cdisc.org/ns/odm/v1.2" for Define-XML v1.0; 2) CDISC Define xmlns:def="http://www.cdisc.org/ns/def/v2.1" for Define-XML v2.1, xmlns:def="http://www.cdisc.org/ns/def/v2.0" for Define-XML v2.0 or xmlns:def="http://www.cdisc.org/ns/def/v1.0" for Define-XML v1.0; 3) XML Schema Instance xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"; and 4) XLink xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink". The XML Schema Instance namespace is only required when a local schema is provided, while the XLink namespace is only required when external documents are provided.
Required attributes must be included in Define.xml and cannot be empty.

message: Attribute <attribute> is not allowed to appear in element <element>
description: Define.xml must only contain attributes that are defined in either ODM or Define-XML specification.
Required elements must be included in Define.xml and cannot be empty.

message: Invalid content was found starting with element <element>
description: Define.xml must only contain elements that are defined in either ODM or Define-XML specifications. The elements must also follow the cardinality and order specified in the specifications.

message: Element in wrong position within Define.xml
description: An element was found in the wrong position within Define.xml.
Element occurs in Define.xml more than once, but it is limited to only one occurrence by the specification.

message: ODM attribute <attribute> should not be included in Define.xml
description: ODM attributes that are not explicitly specified in Define.xml standard should generally not be included.

message: ODM element <element> should not be included in Define.xml
description: ODM elements that are not explicitly specified in Define.xml standard should generally not be included.
The ID attribute for Document must be unique within Define.xml. Define-XML specification represents Documents as def:leaf elements within MetaDataVersion element.
The OID attribute for Method (the Method ID) must be unique within Define.xml. Define-XML specification represents Methods as MethodDef elements within MetaDataVersion element.
The OID attribute for def:ValueListDef element must be unique within a single MetaDataVersion.
Referenced Document must first be defined on Documents tab. Define-XML specification represents Documents as def:leaf elements within MetaDataVersion element.
Referenced Method must first be defined on Methods tab. Define-XML specification represents Methods as MethodDef elements within MetaDataVersion element.

message: Referenced Value Level metadata is missing
description: Referenced ValueListOID value must match OID attribute of def:ValueListDef element within MetaDataVersion element.
The ItemGroupDef def:ArchiveLocationID should match the ID of the child def:leaf.
The FileType must have a value of 'Snapshot'.
The def:DefineVersion should have a value of '2.0.0' for Define-XML v2.0 or '2.1.n' for Define-XML v2.1. The n in '2.1.n' reflects updates to the schema.
notes: PMDA does accept the define.xml version 2.0.0 and 2.1.n only under this validation rule.

description: Allowable values of Standard Name are: Values from the STDNAM Codelist in Define-CT for Define-XML v2.1, 'SDTM-IG', 'SEND-IG', 'SEND-IG-AR', 'SEND-IG-DART', 'SEND-IG-GENETOX', 'ADaM-IG', or 'BIMO' for Define-XML v2.0, or 'CDISC SDTM', 'CDISC SEND', or 'CDISC ADaM' for Define-XML v1.0. Values must conform to this list of values. Note: Refer to the data standards catalog by the relevant Regulatory Agency for acceptance of standards and their versions.

Standard Version must have a valid value for the given Standard Name. Allowed values are '3.1.2', '3.1.3', '3.2', '3.3', or '3.4' for SDTM-IG, '3.0', '3.1', or '3.1.1' for SEND-IG, '1.0' for SEND-IG-AR, '1.1' for SEND-IG-DART, '1.0' for SEND-IG-GENETOX, '1.0', '1.1', '1.2', or '1.3' for ADaM-IG, and '1.0' for BIMO. Define-XML specification represents Standard Version as def:StandardVersion attribute on MetaDataVersion element. Note: Refer to the data standards catalog by the relevant Regulatory Agency for acceptance of standards and their versions.

message: Invalid Term in codelist <codelist> for variable <variable>
description: If the allowed values for a variable are restricted by a non-extensible CDISC controlled terminology, the Codelist referenced in Define.xml must not contain Terms that are not part of CDISC controlled terminology. Define-XML specification represents Term as CodedValue attribute on either EnumeratedItem or CodeListItem elements within CodeList element.

MedDRA version must be set to decimal value ending with 0 or 1, for example '9.0' or '14.1'. Define-XML specification represents MedDRA version as Version attribute on ExternalCodeList element within CodeList element.

Codelist Term must match the value in CDISC Controlled Terminology for corresponding NCI Code. Define-XML specification represents Term as CodedValue attribute on either EnumeratedItem or CodeListItem elements within CodeList element. NCI Code is represented as Name attribute on Alias element when Context attribute is "nci:ExtCodeID".

message: Required attribute def:ExtendedValue is missing or empty
description: The def:ExtendedValue attribute is required when the CodedValue is an extended value.
The def:ExtendedValue attribute must have a value of 'Yes'.

NCI Code is required for each Codelist that is defined in CDISC Controlled Terminology. Define-XML specification represents NCI Code as Name attribute on Alias element when Context attribute is "nci:ExtCodeID".

message: Missing NCI Code for Term in Codelist <codelist>
description: NCI Code is required for each Codelist Term that is defined in CDISC Controlled Terminology. Define-XML specification represents Term as CodedValue attribute on either EnumeratedItem or CodeListItem elements within CodeList element. NCI Code is represented as Name attribute on Alias element when Context attribute is "nci:ExtCodeID".

message: Unknown NCI Code value for Codelist <codelist>
description: NCI Code for Codelist must exist in CDISC Controlled Terminology. Define-XML specification represents NCI Code as Name attribute on Alias element when Context attribute is "nci:ExtCodeID".

message: Unknown NCI Code value for Term in Codelist <codelist>
description: NCI Code for Codelist Term must exist in CDISC Controlled Terminology. Define-XML specification represents Term as CodedValue attribute on either EnumeratedItem or CodeListItem elements within CodeList element. NCI Code is represented as Name attribute on Alias element when Context attribute is "nci:ExtCodeID".

For Define-XML v2.0, the Pages field is required when Origin Type is 'CRF'. For Define-XML v2.1, the Pages field is required when Origin Type is 'Collected' and Source is 'Investigator' or 'Subject'. Define-XML specification represents Pages as def:PDFPageRef elements within def:DocumentRef element.
FirstPage and LastPage are required when PageRefs is not provided.

message: Missing Value Level metadata for QVAL in Dataset <dataset>
description: Value Level metadata must be defined for QVAL variable in each SUPPQUAL dataset. Define-XML specification represents Value Level metadata as def:ValueListDef element, which is referenced from ItemDef/def:ValueListRef element.

Key Variables must be defined for each dataset. Define-XML specification represents Key Variables as KeySequence attribute on ItemRef element. The KeySequence attribute must be provided for at least one ItemRef within each ItemGroupDef.
The KeySequence attribute for ItemRef element must be unique within a single ItemGroupDef.
The Method field is required when Origin is Derived. Define-XML specification represents Methods as MethodDef elements, which are referenced by MethodOID attribute within ItemRef element.
The SoftHard attribute must have a value of 'Soft' or 'Hard'.

For SDTM and SEND submission data (where def:StandardName is 'SDTM-IG' or 'SEND-IG'), Domain attribute is required and must be included in Define.xml and cannot be empty. Note: Refer to the data standards catalog by the relevant Regulatory Agency for acceptance of standards and their versions.
For ADaM submission data (where def:StandardName is 'ADaM-IG'), Domain attribute is not applicable and must not be included in Define.xml.
For regulatory submission data, SASDatasetName attribute is required and must be included in Define.xml and cannot be empty.
The SASDatasetName value does not conform to SAS Transport file naming rules. Allowed string pattern for SASDatasetName is '[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*'.

For SDTM and SEND submission data and for datasets that are not SUPPQUAL and not split (where def:StandardName is 'SDTM-IG' or 'SEND-IG' and only one ItemGroupDef exists for the Domain), Name, Domain, and SASDatasetName attributes must have the same value. Note: Refer to the data standards catalog by the relevant Regulatory Agency for acceptance of standards and their versions.
For split datasets (where more than one ItemGroupDef exists for the same Domain), the 2-letter prefix in SASDatasetName attribute and Domain attribute must have the same value.
The SASDatasetName attribute for ItemGroupDef element must be unique within a single MetaDataVersion.
SASDatasetName attribute and filename (without extension) identified by def:ArchiveLocationID (def:leaf/xlink:href attribute) must have the same value.

The Purpose attribute must have a value of 'Tabulation' for SDTM and SEND data and 'Analysis' for ADaM data. Note: Refer to the data standards catalog by the relevant Regulatory Agency for acceptance of standards and their versions.

For regulatory submission data, Class field is required and must be included in Define.xml and cannot be empty. Define-XML v2.0 specification represents Class as def:Class attribute on ItemGroupDef element. Define-XML v2.1 specification represents Class as a def:Class child element under the ItemGroupDef element.

For Define-XML 2.0, the Class attribute must have a value of 'SPECIAL PURPOSE', 'FINDINGS', 'FINDINGS ABOUT', 'EVENTS', 'INTERVENTIONS', 'TRIAL DESIGN', or 'RELATIONSHIP' for SDTM and SEND data and 'SUBJECT LEVEL ANALYSIS DATASET', 'BASIC DATA STRUCTURE', 'OCCURRENCE DATA STRUCTURE' (IG v1.1 and above), or 'ADAM OTHER' for ADaM data. For Define-XML 2.1, the Class attribute must have a value that is found in the GNRLOBSC (C103329) codelist in Define-CT. Note: Refer to the data standards catalog by the relevant Regulatory Agency for acceptance of standards and their versions.
For regulatory submission data, def:ArchiveLocationID attribute is required and must be included in Define.xml and cannot be empty.

For regulatory submission data, Description field is required for each Dataset, Method, and Comment and must be included in Define.xml and cannot be empty. Define-XML specification represents Description as Description/TranslatedText element within ItemGroupDef, MethodDef, or def:CommentDef element.

Label field is required for each Variable and must be included in Define.xml and cannot be empty. However, Label field is optional for Value Level metadata. Define-XML specification represents Label as Description/TranslatedText element within ItemDef element.
The Predecessor field is required when Origin is Predecessor. Define-XML specification represents Predecessors as Description/TranslatedText elements within def:Origin element.
The xml:lang attribute for TranslatedText element must be unique within a single parent element.
Alias is required for each split dataset (where more than one ItemGroupDef exists for the same Domain) to provide a description for the full dataset.
The Alias Context attribute must have a value of 'DomainDescription' for split datasets (when child of ItemGroupDef) and 'nci:ExtCodeID' for CodeList, CodeListItem or EnumeratedItem elements.

Only Variables that are referenced from a Dataset or Value Level metadata should be included in Define.xml. Define-XML specification represents variables as ItemDef elements and variable references as ItemRef elements within an ItemGroupDef or def:ValueListDef.
The Length attribute must be empty when DataType is not integer, float, or text.
The Significant Digits attribute must be empty when DataType is not float.
For regulatory submission data, SASFieldName attribute is required and must be included in Define.xml and cannot be empty.
Referenced Comment must first be defined on Comments tab. Define-XML specification represents Comments as def:CommentDef elements within MetaDataVersion element.

For regulatory submission data, Origin is required for all SDTM, ADaM, and SEND variables. It is at the sponsors discretion whether to provide Origin at the Variable or Value Level. When Origin is provided for each Value Level item, then providing Origin on the Variable is optional. Define-XML specification represents variable Origin as def:Origin element under ItemDef element. Note: Refer to the data standards catalog by the relevant Regulatory Agency for acceptance of standards and their versions.

For Define-XML v2.0, the Origin Type attribute must have a value of 'CRF', 'Derived', 'Assigned', 'Protocol', 'eDT', or 'Predecessor' for SDTM and ADaM data and 'COLLECTED', 'DERIVED', 'OTHER', or 'NOT AVAILABLE' for SEND data. For Define-XML v2.1, the Origin Type attribute must have a value of 'Collected', 'Derived', 'Assigned', 'Protocol', or 'Predecessor' for SDTM, 'Collected', 'Derived', 'Assigned', 'Protocol', 'Other', 'Predecessor', or 'Not Available' for SEND, and 'Derived', 'Assigned', or 'Predecessor' for ADaM.
When Origin is provided at both the Variable and Value Level, then Origin Type values must match.

message: CRF Origin is not referencing AnnotatedCRF
description: For Define-XML v2.0, when def:Origin/@Type is 'CRF', then def:DocumentRef must match the def:DocumentRef in def:AnnotatedCRF element. For Define-XML v2.1, when def:Origin/@Type is 'Collected' and def:Origin/@Source is 'Investigator' or 'Subject', then def:DocumentRef must match the def:DocumentRef in def:AnnotatedCRF element.
If Rank value is provided for any Codelist item (EnumeratedItem or CodeListItem) within a Codelist, it must be provided for all other items as well.
If Order number is provided for any Codelist item (EnumeratedItem or CodeListItem) within a Codelist, it must be provided for all other items as well.
Only Documents that are referenced from a Method or Comment should be included in Define.xml. Define-XML specification represents Documents as def:leaf elements within MetaDataVersion element.

Only Comments that are referenced from Standards/Terminologies, Dataset, Variable, Value Level metadata, or Codelists should be included in Define.xml. Define-XML specification represents Comments as def:CommentDef elements within MetaDataVersion element.

Only Methods that are referenced from a Variable or Value Level metadata should be included in Define.xml. Define-XML specification represents Methods as MethodDef elements within MetaDataVersion element.

message: Value Level metadata <value level> is not referenced
description: Only Value Level metadata that are referenced from a Variable should be included in Define.xml. Define-XML specification represents Value Level metadata as def:ValueListDef elements within MetaDataVersion element.

Only Codelists that are referenced from a Variable or Value Level metadata should be included in Define.xml. Define-XML specification represents Codelists as CodeList elements within MetaDataVersion element.
The OID attribute for Comment (the Comment ID) must be unique within Define.xml. Define-XML specification represents Comments as def:CommentDef elements within MetaDataVersion element.
Referenced File must exist. Define-XML specification represents File references as xlink:href attributes within def:leaf element.
Stylesheet (".xsl") file referenced in Define.xml must exist.

message: ARM metadata included in non ADaM define.xml
description: Analysis Results Metadata was developed specifically for ADaM and therefore should not be included with SDTM or SEND defines. Analysis Results Metadata inclusion is indicated by the presence of the arm:AnalysisResultDisplays element. Note: Refer to the data standards catalog by the relevant Regulatory Agency for acceptance of standards and their versions.
The OID for an arm:ResultDisplay element must be unique within the arm:AnalysisResultDisplays element.
The name of an arm:ResultDisplay should uniquely identify the display in the report (e.g. Table or Figure number).
A Description element must be included in each arm:ResultDisplay.
The OID for an arm:AnalysisResult must be unique within a arm:ResultDisplay.
ParameterOID is required when the analysis result is based on specific parameter(s) from a BDS structured dataset.

When ParameterOID is included in a arm:AnalysisResult, then at least one of the children arm:AnalysisDataset elements must be a BDS and the ParamerterOID must reference a PARAMCD variable for that Dataset.
def:CommentOID is required if there is more than one analysis dataset needed to create the respective result.
ItemGroupOID attribute on arm:AnalysisDataset must reference a valid ItemGroupDef

At least one analysis variable element must be available for any given analysis result. If there are more than one analysis dataset specified for a specific result, the analysis variable element may be available for one of the respective datasets only.
ItemOID attribute on arm:AnalysisVariable must reference a valid ItemDef.
When any arm:Code elements are provided the language or software used for them should be provided in the Context attribute (e.g. SQL or SAS 9.2).
Values for the AnalysisReason attribute are controlled by the Analysis Reason extensible codelist in ADaM CT or Define CT.
Values for the AnalysisPurpose attribute are controlled by the Analysis Purpose extensible codelist in ADaM CT or Define CT.

Guidance provided by regulatory agencies states that eCTD submissions must include a define.xml file for each study in Module 4 (nonclinical) and Module 5 (clinical). Note: Refer to the data standards catalog by the relevant Regulatory Agency for acceptance of standards and their versions.
Guidance provided by regulatory agencies states that the Annotated CRF should be provided as a PDF with the file name 'acrf.pdf'.

A variable in Define.xml has the origin of CRF and references specific pages, however Define.xml does not contain an Annotated CRF. The Annotated CRF is represented by the def:AnnotatedCRF element within MetaDataVersion element.
The Type attribute for Method must have a value of 'Computation' or 'Imputation'.

message: Origin for Study Day variable <define variable> is not set to Derived
description: In SDTM, all --DY, --STDY, and --ENDY variables must have Origin set to 'Derived'.

message: Origin for DOMAIN variable is not set to Assigned
description: Domain Abbreviation (DOMAIN) variable should have Origin set to 'Assigned'.

message: Origin for RDOMAIN variable is not set to Assigned
description: Related Domain Abbreviation (RDOMAIN) variable should have Origin set to 'Assigned'.

message: Origin for STUDYID variable is not set to Protocol
description: Study Identifier (STUDYID) variable should have Origin set to 'Protocol'.
The Origin for Unique Subject Identifier (USUBJID) variable should be consistent across all datasets.
The Origin for Visit Number (VISITNUM) variable should be consistent across all datasets.

For Define-XML v2.0, the Pages field must be empty when Origin Type is not 'CRF'. For Define-XML v2.1, the Pages field is required when Origin Type is 'Collected' and Source is 'Investigator' or 'Subject'. Define-XML specification represents Pages as def:PDFPageRef elements within def:DocumentRef element.

MedDRA dictionary and version must be specified in Define.xml for regulatory submissions. Define-XML specification represents MedDRA as Dictionary and Version attributes on ExternalCodeList element within CodeList element.

message: Missing MedDRA reference on <define variable> variable
description: Variables --LLT, --LLTCD, --DECOD, --PTCD, --HLT, --HLTCD, --HLGT, --HLGTCD, --BODSYS, --BDSYCD, --SOC, and --SOCCD must reference MedDRA dictionary for regulatory submissions.

message: Invalid usage of split datasets for non-general-observation-class datasets
description: Split datasets can only be used for general-observation-class datasets (Events, Findings, Findings About, Interventions).

message: Split and unsplit datasets are both listed
description: Split and unsplit datasets cannot both be listed in Define.xml. For FDA submissions, Define.xml should only list unsplit datasets with split datasets placed in a separate sub-directory labeled 'split'.
When SDTM Event or Intervention qualifier variable is used as FATESTCD, then FATEST should be the corresponding qualifier variable label.

message: Incomplete Documentation for Analysis Results Metadata
description: When an Analysis Results Metadata references an External Document, a description for that document is required. The Document Description is represented as a Description element inside the arm:Documentation element.

message: NCI Code <define codelist code> for Codelist <define codelist> on Variable <define variable> does not match NCI Code <standard codelist code> for Standard Codelist <standard codelist> for Variable <standard variable>
description: When using a standard codelist in define.xml, the NCI code should match.
The PublishingSet attribute is required when Type is 'CT'.

message: Invalid use of IsNonStandard for Dataset
description: The IsNonStandard attribute must not be populated when the dataset is standard.
The IsNonStandard attribute must be populated when the dataset is not standard (i.e., does not have a def:StandardOID attribute).
The referenced CDISC standard must be defined in a def:Standard element.
The length of a value level slice must be less than or equal to the length of the parent variable.

Variables defined in a Standard with a Controlled Terminology requirement must have a codelist. Define-XML defines codelists using the CodeList element and references to those using CodeListRef elements.
The referenced CT standard must be defined in a def:Standard element with Type='CT'.

message: Invalid use of IsNonStandard for Codelist
description: The IsNonStandard attribute must not be populated when the codelist is standard.

message: Invalid use of NCI Code for Codelist
description: An NCI Code must not be provided when a codelist is non-standard (i.e., codelist does not have a Terminology version defined).
The IsNonStandard attribute must be populated when the codelist is not standard (i.e., does not have a def:StandardOID attribute).
An NCI code must be provided if the def:StandardOID attribute is set on the CodeList in order to verify that CodeList exists in the terminology.
The def:IsNonStandard attribute must have a value of 'Yes'.
The Name attribute for CodeList (the CodeList Name) must be unique within Define.xml. Define-XML specification represents Codelists as CodeList elements within MetaDataVersion element.
For codelists that are non-extensible, the def:ExtendedValue attribute is not applicable and must not be included.

The def:CommentOID attribute is required when the value of the ItemGroupDef def:HasNoData attribute is 'Yes'. A comment must be included to explain why no data are present for datasets that were planned for use in the study.

The def:CommentOID attribute is required for an ItemDef when its ItemOID is referenced in an ItemRef that has the def:HasNoData attribute value 'Yes'. A comment must be included to explain why no data is present for the dataset's variables that were planned for use in the study.
The value of the Repeating attribute must be 'No' when IsReferenceData='Yes'.

The value of the English dataset's description must match the one specified in the CDISC standard for an ItemGroupDef element that represents a dataset defined as following an SDTMIG or SENDIG standard.

The value of an English variable's description must match the one specified in the CDISC standard for an ItemDef element that represents a dataset's variable defined as following an SDTMIG or SENDIG standard.
The referenced standard (name and version), is not valid or could not be found.

Only Standards that are referenced from a Dataset or Codelist should be included in Define.xml. Define-XML specification represents Standards as def:Standard elements within the def:Standards element.

message: Invalid use of Subclass for Class
description: The value of the Name attribute in the def:SubClass element must be one of the values from the CDISC/NCI subclass codelists.
The value of the Status attribute must be one of the values from the CDISC/NCI standard Status codelist included in the Define-XML Controlled Terminology (C172332).

Define-XML defines Predecessor as a value that is copied from a variable in another dataset. The Description child element identifies the dataset and variable that is copied. To enable other validation rules, the structure of this column needs to be in the form of DATASET.VARIABLE.

Invalid combination of def:Standard elements found in a v2.1 define.xml file. For SEND, at least two Standards must be defined: (1) where Type='IG' and Name begins with 'SENDIG' and (2) where Type='CT' and PublishingSet='SEND'. For SDTM, at least two Standards must be defined: (1) where Type='IG' and Name='SDTMIG' and (2) where Type='CT' and PublishingSet='SDTM'. For ADaM, at least two Standards must be defined: (1) where Type='IG' and Name='ADaMIG', and (2) where Type='CT' and PublishingSet='SDTM' or where Type='CT' and PublishingSet='ADaM'.
Define.xml must contain well-formed XML.
Define.xml must start with an XML declaration.
Define.xml must use UTF-8, UTF-16, or ISO-8859-1 encoding.
Define.xml must contain a root element called ODM.
Attribute is defined as an integer, but value does not match the integer format. Allowed string pattern for an integer is '-?digit+'.
Attribute is defined as a datetime, but value does not match the datetime format. Allowed string pattern for a datetime is 'YYYY-MM-DD T hh:mm:ss(.n+)? ((+|-)hh:mm)?'.
Attribute is defined as a sasFormat, but value does not match the SAS Format naming conventions. Allowed string pattern for a sasFormat is '(letter|_|$)(letter|digit|_|.)*'.
Attribute is defined as a language tag, but value does not match the language tag format. Allowed values are specified in IETF RFC 3066: Tags for the Identification of Languages.
The OID attribute for Study element must be unique within a related series of ODM documents.
The OID attribute for MetaDataVersion element must be unique within a single study.
The OID attribute for ItemGroupDef element must be unique within a single MetaDataVersion.
The OID attribute for ItemDef element must be unique within a single MetaDataVersion.
The OID attribute for CodeList (the CodeList ID) must be unique within Define.xml. Define-XML specification represents Codelists as CodeList elements within MetaDataVersion element.
The ItemOID attribute for ItemRef element must be unique within a single ItemGroupDef.
The Order number attribute must be unique.
The value of ItemOID attribute references a non-existent ItemDef element.
Referenced Codelist must first be defined on Codelists tab. Define-XML specification represents Codelists as CodeList elements within MetaDataVersion element.
The Length attribute is required when DataType is integer, float, or text.
The Significant Digits attribute is required when DataType is float.
The Repeating attribute for Dataset must have a value of 'Yes' or 'No'. Define-XML specification represents Datasets as ItemGroupDef elements within MetaDataVersion element.
The IsReferenceData attribute for Dataset must have a value of 'Yes' or 'No'. Define-XML specification represents Datasets as ItemGroupDef elements within MetaDataVersion element.
The Mandatory attribute must have a value of 'Yes' or 'No'.

message: Invalid Data Type value for variable
description: The Data Type attribute for Variable must have a value of 'text', 'integer', 'float', 'datetime', 'date', or 'time' for Define-XML v1.0, and 'text', 'integer', 'float', 'datetime', 'date', 'time', 'partialDate', 'partialTime', 'partialDatetime', 'incompleteDatetime', or 'durationDatetime' for Define-XML v2.0 and v2.1.

message: Invalid Data Type value for codelist
description: The Data Type attribute for Codelist must have a value of 'text, 'integer', or 'float'.

Codelist Term must match the Data Type of the containing CodeList. Define-XML specification represents Term as CodedValue attribute on either EnumeratedItem or CodeListItem elements within CodeList element.

message: Invalid SASFormatName value for text Codelist
description: When CodeList DataType is 'text' the SASFormatName should start with a '$'.
The Term must be unique within a Codelist. Define-XML specification represents Term as CodedValue attribute on either EnumeratedItem or CodeListItem elements within CodeList element.
Variable Data Type must match the Data Type of the referenced Codelist. Define-XML specification represents Variable as ItemDef.

Codelist must have at least one item. Define-XML specification allows Codelists to contain 3 types of items: 1) list of Terms (EnumeratedItem); 2) list of Terms and Decoded Values (CodeListItem); 3) or a reference to external dictionary (ExternalCodeList).
When Codelist contains at least one item with Term and Decoded Value (CodeListItem), then all other items must be of the same type.
